GAB.note: Pilot Wi-Fi hotspots in four schools only; a schools-only programme is not a rural access programme.

facts.fact: SPIN states that the Backbone National Gabonais fibre optic network supports the Wi-Fi hotspots put into service 9-11 December 2024 in schools at Bakoumba, Bongoville and Léconi (Haut-Ogooué) and Oyem (Woleu-Ntem).

GAB.note: No share of secondary schools with internet and no curriculum statement; four pilot hotspots only.
